# netbox_cooling_source (Resource)

From the [official documentation](https://docs.netbox.dev/en/stable/models/dcim/coolingsource/):

> A cooling source is a facility device such as a chiller or a cooling tower that supplies cooling to cooling feeds.

Requires NetBox v4.7.0 or newer.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netbox_cooling_source" "example" {
  name = "example"
  site_id = netbox_site.test.id
  type = "chiller"
  status = "active"
  cooling_capacity = 100
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)
- `site_id` (Number)
- `type` (String) One of [chiller, cooling-tower, dry-cooler, crac, crah].

### Optional

- `comments` (String)
- `cooling_capacity` (Number) Total rated cooling capacity (kW).
- `custom_fields` (Map of String)
- `description` (String)
- `fluid_type` (String) One of [water, water-glycol, dielectric, refrigerant].
- `location_id` (Number)
- `owner_id` (Number)
- `status` (String) One of [offline, active, planned, failed].
- `tags` (Set of String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `tags_all` (Set of String)
